data.content: For each species return the avg ratioTU and the 25th and 75th percentile of ratios across all sites?

args.query: For each species (algae, daphnia/crustaceans, fish), compute across all sites and time points: the average ratioTU and the 25th and 75th percentiles of ratioTU. If ratioTU is stored per site-time-species, aggregate accordingly. Return a table with species, avg_ratioTU, p25_ratioTU, p75_ratioTU.

            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (site:Site)-[r:SUMMARIZED_IMPACT_ON]->(sp:Species)
WHERE sp.name IN ['algae','crustacean','fish'] AND r.ratioTU IS NOT NULL
WITH sp.name AS species, r.ratioTU AS ratio
RETURN species,
       avg(ratio) AS avg_ratioTU,
       percentileCont(ratio, 0.25) AS p25_ratioTU,
       percentileCont(ratio, 0.75) AS p75_ratioTU
ORDER BY species
            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
